name: AgentSEO MCP Server
description: SEO intelligence tools for AI agents: SERPs, keyword research, backlinks, rank tracking, content planning, and site audits. Requires an AgentSEO account and API key; API usage consumes credits.

AGENTSEO_API_KEY.description: Your AgentSEO workspace API key. Obtain your own key from https://www.agentseo.dev; API usage consumes credits.

AGENTSEO_API_URL.description: AgentSEO API base URL used by the local MCP client.

AGENTSEO_PROJECT_ID.description: Optional default project attribution for tool calls.

AGENTSEO_WORKFLOW_ID.description: Optional default workflow attribution for tool calls.
